menu.name: Ofada Rice with Ayamase
menu.description: Local ofada rice with the famous green-pepper designer stew, assorted meat and boiled egg.

menu.name: Fried Rice and Beef/Plantain
menu.description: Flavorful, perfectly seasoned fried rice served with tender, juicy beef and sweet, golden-fried plantain. A delicious combination of savory goodness and irresistible sweetness in every bite.

menu.name: White Rice
menu.description: Fluffy long-grain white rice, steamed until every grain stands apart. The easy partner for any of our stews, sauces and proteins.

menu.name: Jollof Rice
menu.description: Long-grain rice slow-cooked in a rich tomato and red pepper base until it takes on that deep orange glow and the smoky, party-style flavor everyone waits for.

menu.name: Fried Rice
menu.description: Golden fried rice tossed with diced carrots, green peas, sweetcorn and green beans, lightly seasoned and bursting with color.

menu.name: Coconut Rice
menu.description: Rice simmered in coconut milk with a gentle touch of pepper. Soft, fragrant and quietly rich.

menu.name: Asun Rice
menu.description: Rice tossed with asun, spicy smoked goat meat, with sliced onions and red peppers. Smoky, peppery and bold.

menu.name: Native Rice
menu.description: Traditional palm-oil rice cooked with crayfish, dried fish and fragrant scent leaves. Earthy, deeply savory and full of home-style flavor.

menu.name: Egusi Soup with Pounded Yam
menu.description: Rich melon-seed soup loaded with assorted meat and stockfish, served with soft, freshly pounded yam.

menu.name: SeaFood Okro + Semo.
menu.description: A rich and flavorful seafood okro soup, loaded with fresh seafood and traditional Nigerian spices. Served with smooth, soft semolina (Semo) for the perfect taste of home in every bite.

menu.name: Vegetable Soup + Eba/Poundo/Semo
menu.description: A rich and delicious vegetable soup, packed with fresh leafy greens, flavorful spices, and tender assorted proteins. Served with your choice of soft Poundo, Eba, or Semo for a hearty and satisfying taste of home.

menu.name: Oha Soup
menu.description: A treasured Eastern soup, thickened with cocoyam and finished with tender oha leaves, simmered with meat and stockfish into a rich, comforting bowl.

menu.name: Egusi Soup
menu.description: Ground melon seeds cooked down in palm oil with leafy greens and meat. Thick, nutty and generous, and best enjoyed with your choice of swallow.

menu.name: Afang Soup
menu.description: A Calabar classic of finely shredded afang leaves and waterleaf, cooked in palm oil with meat and periwinkles. Rich, green and deeply satisfying.

menu.name: Vegetable Soup
menu.description: Fresh ugu and waterleaf cooked down in palm oil with meat and stockfish. A wholesome, vibrant soup that pairs beautifully with any swallow.

menu.name: Ogbono Soup
menu.description: Ground ogbono seeds simmered into a smooth, silky draw soup with leafy greens and meat. Earthy, comforting and made for swallow.

menu.name: Okra Soup
menu.description: Freshly chopped okra cooked into a light, silky draw soup with meat and a gentle warmth of pepper.

menu.name: Seafood Okra
menu.description: Our okra soup loaded with prawns, crab, periwinkles and fish. Light, silky and full of the fresh taste of the sea.

menu.name: Fisherman Soup
menu.description: A Rivers-style soup of fresh fish, prawns, crab and periwinkles in a rich, peppery red broth. Hearty, warming and generous.

menu.name: Efo Riro
menu.description: Chopped spinach stewed in a rich red pepper and palm oil sauce with tender meat. A Yoruba favorite with bold, savory depth.

menu.name: Eba
menu.description: Garri stirred with hot water into a smooth, firm swallow, soft enough to shape and perfect for scooping up any soup.

menu.name: Semo
menu.description: A smooth, light swallow made from semolina. Soft and mild, an easy partner for every soup on our menu.

menu.name: Pounded Yam
menu.description: Yam pounded until smooth, soft and stretchy. The classic partner for egusi, ogbono and every rich soup.

menu.name: Amala
menu.description: Soft, dark swallow made from yam flour, with a gentle earthy taste. Wonderful with efo riro or ogbono soup.

menu.name: Wheat
menu.description: A smooth, light brown swallow made from wheat flour. Soft and mild with a slightly nutty taste.

menu.name: Fufu
menu.description: Fermented cassava swallow, soft and smooth with a gentle tang. A traditional favorite with any rich soup.

menu.name: Beans and Plantain
menu.description: Deliciously cooked beans seasoned with flavorful spices and served with sweet, golden-fried plantain. A hearty, comforting Nigerian classic that delivers the perfect balance of savory goodness and natural sweetness.

menu.name: Boiled Yam

menu.name: Yam Porridge

menu.name: Boiled Plantain
